name: Louisiana

law.name: Louisiana athlete agent law, rewritten in 2026 (R.S. 4:420 and following)

covers_nil_agents: Yes. Paid NIL or endorsement advice is agent work, for high school and college athletes.
summary: Register online with the Attorney General. $1,000, plus a background check and NIL training. Good for 2 years.

steps.text: Apply on the Attorney General's NIL portal
steps.detail: Includes 5 years of jobs and licenses, 3 references, a headshot and a bio.
$500 if you're already registered in another state.

steps.text: Finish the background check and NIL training
steps.detail: Run by Advance NIL after you pay. Usually 2 to 7 business days.

steps.text: Register with each school's compliance office, if it asks
steps.detail: Most schools have their own agent sign-up.

steps.text: Sign a written NIL disclosure with the athlete before you start
steps.detail: Your registration, fee, anyone else paid, expenses, services, length and date. Without it you lose your fee.

steps.text: Help the athlete report the deal to their school
Pro contracts: tell the athletic director and coach 7 days before contact
Pro contracts: notify them again within 72 hours of signing
Pro contracts: send signed contracts to the Attorney General
Date the contract the day it's signed
steps.detail: Federal law (SPARTA) bans pre-dating or post-dating it.
Names and addresses, contracts and recruiting costs.

steps.text: Never give gifts or money to recruit athletes or make false promises
steps.detail: This is a state and federal (SPARTA) rule.
$1,000 ($500 if your registration is based on another state's).

watch_list.item: Federal Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (S.4668)
watch_list.status: Passed the Senate on Sept 28, 2026. The House is out until Nov 9 and leaders say it won't pass as-is. It dies if not enacted by Jan 3, 2027.
watch_list.impact: It would require every NIL agent to register in a state, cap agent fees at 5% of an endorsement deal and limit contracts to the athlete's eligibility.

review_notes: No cancellation right was found in the 2026 act.
The contract and school-notice steps follow the uniform act's standard text. Check them against this state's statute before launch.
